name: Stormbringer (Su)
source: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds
book: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds

facets.bk: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds

body:
The shaman can strike his enemies with a bolt of lightning from the sky. This acts as call lightning, using the shaman’s caster level. Once a creature has been struck by this stormbringer, it cannot suffer the effects again for 24 hours.

At 11th level, this acts as call lightning storm instead.
